about: What each source is expected to give, set by hand and kept apart from sources/manifest.json (which every fetch rewrites). tools/sources_check.py reads both. A count outside its range stops the build (fail closed). Ranges are wide enough for real change and narrow enough to catch a broken read: a page that comes back empty, or a matcher that suddenly doubles its output. Each range says why. Frequency is how often the publisher changes the source, in days; a source read more than twice that long before the build's latest read is reported as stale, not failed, because a dated snapshot is still honest when it is labelled.

base.note: This portal's own earlier build, kept as a fixed starting point; it never changes
